<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    d = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'gGbBrRYN' and n['pixels']>=4:
            d[n['color']+'_'+str(n['pixels'])] = (n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][0][1],n['boundary'][2][0],n['boundary'][2][1])
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    blue = tuple(sorted((r,c) for r in range(10,54) for c in range(0,32) if L[r][c]=='b'))
    return d, blue
d0,b0 = state()
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}])  # blue podium
d1,b1 = state()
print("changed pieces:", {k:(d0.get(k),d1.get(k)) for k in set(d0)|set(d1) if d0.get(k)!=d1.get(k)})
print("blue cells before:", b0)
print("blue cells after: ", b1)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
